name: ecommerce-platform
description: Multipurpose ecommerce platform — deploy multiple storefronts from one codebase.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @platform/shared && npm run build -w @platform/site-config && npm run build -w @platform/api-client
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run build -w @platform/shared && npm run openapi:generate -w @platform/server
scripts.api:generate: npm run openapi:generate && orval --config orval.config.ts && npm run build -w @platform/api-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @platform/shared && npm run typecheck -w @platform/site-config && npm run typecheck -w @platform/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @platform/server && tsc --noEmit -p admin && tsc --noEmit -p client && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
